analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions maintained a buy signal, but today's -4.61% drop fell below SMA5 ($38,121). RSI at 53.8 continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram improvement from 44.7061 to 298.2260 is clear but still in negative territory. Volume ratio is 0.73, indicating contraction. 52-week position at 55.2% is neutral. With ATR at $1,752, stop loss at 1.0-4.0x ATR would range from $35,828 to $30,578. Setting target at $38,775 (swing resistance) allows for a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher, but weak trend reversal signals warrant a wait-and-see approach.
